# Model sources

These are unchanged model files used by the submitted projects. They are hosted alongside the archive to avoid the TF Hub → Kaggle download redirect chain. Original URLs, versions, sizes and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in [manifest.json](manifest.json).

Upstream implementations and licensing information:
- [TensorFlow.js models](https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs-models) — Hand Pose Detection, Face Detection, Face Landmarks Detection and MoveNet.
- [MediaPipe Pose Landmarker models](https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/pose_landmarker#models) — Pose Landmarker Lite, float16, version 1.

Model files and upstream libraries retain their respective upstream licenses. Student artwork licensing does not replace upstream terms. Test camera images and videos are not included in this repository.
